stem_md: 设 $f(x)>0,f'(0)=0$，求 $z=f(x)\ln f(y)$ 在 $(0,0)$ 取極小值的充分條件。
analysis_md:
$$\left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right|_{(0,0)}=f'(x)\ln f(y)\bigg|_{(0,0)}=f'(0)\ln f(0)=0$$

$$\left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\right|_{(0,0)}=f(x)\cdot\frac{f'(y)}{f(y)}\bigg|_{(0,0)}=f(0)\frac{f'(0)}{f(0)}=0$$

$$A=\left.\frac{\partial^2 z}{\partial x^2}\right|_{(0,0)}=f''(x)\ln f(y)\bigg|_{(0,0)}=f''(0)\ln f(0)>0$$

$$B=\left.\frac{\partial^2 z}{\partial x\partial y}\right|_{(0,0)}=f'(x)\cdot\frac{f'(y)}{f(y)}\bigg|_{(0,0)}=\frac{f'^2(0)}{f(0)}=0$$

$$C=\left.\frac{\partial^2 z}{\partial y^2}\right|_{(0,0)}=f(x)\cdot\frac{f(y)f''(y)-f'^2(y)}{f^2(y)}\bigg|_{(0,0)}=f''(0)>0$$

则 $AC-B^2>0$。
